THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
SCULPTED DRAMA
020
VIII
Sculpted Drama
Shape and color
take the lead.
23 / Slate Couture
black beaded-lace mock-neck bodice, a
high-waisted charcoal wool circle skirt
with sculpted seams, glittering black
lace-up boots and long wavy black hair.
Floor-to-ceiling windows, cream bouclé
seating and a swirled rose-and-gray
carpet complete the setting.
FASHION, FILM & VISUAL STUDIES
